messages:
alex.p: quick sync — proposing we standardize the request-id + span headers that runtime emits so dashboards can join logs/traces/metrics. want input from eng-runtime, eng-platform, and devex. @mira @sam @jordan @tia

mira: sgtm. what header names are you thinking?

alex.p: initial thought: keep one canonical request id header -> `X-Request-Id` (already used) and add `X-RW-Span` for per-hop span id. alternative: `X-RW-Trace` with `reqid:span`. pros/cons?

sam: prefer separate headers. concatenated value is annoying to parse in the metrics pipeline and increases error surface. `X-Request-Id` + `X-RW-Span` is clean.

jordan: agree separate. runtime can inject at the accept/proxy layer so apps don't need to touch it. small perf Q: extra header allocs—we need to measure.

alex.p: noted. another thing: sampling. dashboards need sampled traces for example flows. propose deterministic sampling based on request id hash so the same request is consistently sampled across services. pseudo: \n```\n// deterministic sampler\nsample = (farmhash32(reqid) % 100) < SAMPLE_PERCENT\nif (sample) set header X-RW-Sampled: 1\n```

mira: deterministic sampler solves partial coverage issues. +1. what's SAMPLE_PERCENT? per-route config or global?

tia: platform here — dashboards want route, model_variant, and shard as tags to roll up correctly. please have runtime emit sanitized `route` and `model` headers or labels so we avoid high-cardinality raw paths. e.g., `route=/generate` not `/generate?prompt=...`.

ops-bot: heads-up: adding `model` and `route` tags will increase cardinality. platform: please enforce sanitization rules (strip query, prefix-only). also suggest histogram buckets for latency by `model` and `route`.

devex: for rollout UX, console should show per-route trace-coverage % (sampled / total) and a sampled trace example. devex will mock a panel that links from a request row to the sampled trace.

sam: runtime impl note — websocket/proxy flows: conn-level requests may not have `X-Request-Id`. propose we assign a conn-scoped id at accept time and set per-request ids for each message. mapping: `X-Conn-Id` + `X-Request-Id`.

mira: websocket mapping makes sense. also need deterministic sampling to use conn+seq where reqid absent. e.g., `hash(conn_id + seq)` so sampling stays sticky.

jordan: will run perf spike: 1000 RPS synthetic with headers on/off to measure allocation/latency. will report memory + p50/p99 changes.

alex.p: ops: can platform add ingestion filters to drop raw query strings and collapse common model name variants?

tia: yes. platform will add a small sanitizer step in the ingest pipeline and a dedupe for `model` aliases. will also provide a dashboard template we can import.

devex: i can prototype console UX by EOD Friday: panel for trace coverage, sampled trace viewer, and a toggle to filter by `sampled=1`.

mira: i'll draft the header spec PR with examples and a short migration guide for services that already set their own `X-Request-Id`. will include fallback rules.

sam: i'll pick up deterministic sampler implementation in eng-runtime. will add config: `sampling.percent` and `sampling.seed` so we can roll it.

jordan: i'll post perf results and a short runbook for when p99 regresses.

alex.p: ok next steps checklist: 1) spec PR (mira) 2) runtime sampler + ws mapping (sam) 3) platform ingest tags + sanitizer (tia) 4) perf spike (jordan) 5) console mock (devex) 6) rollout plan w/ sample-rate default and opt-out. sync tomorrow 10:00am to review. :thumbsup:
